column1: # The data build of the 30B baseline ablations, one line per corpus, consumed by
# configs/control_pretraining/build_corpora.sh (which submits the jobs and reimplements nothing)
# and checked by verify_corpora.py against the same line. Columns, in order:
#   subset | stage | kind | config | prep_h | tok_h | workers | shards | shard_mode | stripe | docs
#   subset      the HuggingFace config name within the prepare config's dataset; `default` is the
#               config whose `train` split concatenates the mix's per-source configs, so the
#               corpus root is <data base>/<dataset>__default
#   kind        pack -> packed SFT parquet, one per shard, via pipeline_data_submit.sbatch <root>
#   prep_h      the prepare (download + JSONL export) walltime: the 247 GB download and 352 GB
#               export of 8.9M conversations, sized from the filtered arm's 5.65M-conversation
#               prepare at 8 h; workq_qos caps any job at 24 h
#   tok_h       the pack walltime PER SHARD: ~279k conversations each, from the filtered arm's
#               ~353k-conversation shards packing inside 4 h
#   shards      32, byte-gated split of the prepared JSONL. The shard count is set by the PACK
#               job's host memory, not by its walltime: the packer materialises every pack of a
#               shard in host RAM before writing the parquet, so a shard's peak memory scales
#               with its pack count. At 16 shards this corpus packs to ~95,600 per shard and
#               eleven of sixteen jobs were OOM-killed at the node's 449 GB ceiling, in the
#               assembly phase after a clean tokenize (2026-09-13). 32 shards give ~47,800 per
#               shard, the size every filtered-arm SFT shard packed at (46,848)
#   docs        the default split's row count at the pinned revision, from the dataset card;
#               the verifier checks the prepared JSONL against it
# Only the xl-50b SFT ablation's corpus is built here; the mainline mix the ablation is compared
# against is the baseline arm's own build.
